cases.title: The Last Debate
cases.introduction: On the eve of election week, a policy forum ends in chaos. A senator collapses backstage, and the ceremonial blade displayed for photos is drenched.
cases.resolution: The chief of staff silenced the senator before a corruption vote. The knife was never meant to leave its case—yet fingerprints say otherwise.

clues.hint: Podiums, press risers, and debate rules where ideas become weapons.
clues.reaction: Backstage access lists exclude the public but include senior aides.
clues.investigatePrompt: Find the five-letter debate hall where the attack occurred.

clues.hint: Displayed under glass for ceremony—steel polished for cameras, not combat.
clues.reaction: Blood on the guard matches the senator's type, wiped hastily with a flag.
clues.investigatePrompt: Identify the five-letter ceremonial blade.

clues.hint: Controls the narrative, schedules interviews, and knew exactly when the senator would be alone backstage.
clues.reaction: A press badge was swiped at the stage door after hours—yet the handler claims they filed stories from the parking lot.
clues.investigatePrompt: Uncover the five-letter word for the media team at the forum.
